```{r}
library(ggplot2)
hotdogs <- read.csv("C:\\Users\\jjsut\\Downloads\\Hotdog Survey (Responses) - Form Responses 1.csv")
```

```{r}
ggplot(hotdogs, aes(x=Is.a.Hotdog.a.Sandwich., fill=What.is.your.Gender.Identity.))+geom_bar(position='dodge')
```

```{r}
ggplot(hotdogs, aes(x=Is.a.Hotdog.a.Sandwich., fill=Year.at.UVA))+geom_bar(position='dodge')
```
